name: Dover AFB
description: Home of the 436th Airlift Wing. Dover AFB is the Department of Defense's largest aerial port and primary East Coast air mobility hub, supporting global airlift operations.

currentNotifications.title: REAL ID Required for Base Access
currentNotifications.body: A REAL ID-compliant driver's license or equivalent is required for base access per DHS mandate.

gates.name: North Gate
gates.hours: Mon-Fri 0600-1800; closed weekends and federal holidays

gates.name: South Gate
gates.hours: Mon-Fri 0600-1800; closed weekends and federal holidays

gates.name: Visitor Control Center (Bldg 520)
gates.notes: REAL ID or alternate ID docs required. Phone: 302-677-3645; after-hours 302-677-6664.

resources.name: Patterson Dining Facility
resources.description: Primary DFAC supporting air mobility operations with full meal service including midnight meals.
resources.hours: Mon-Fri: Breakfast 0600-0830, Lunch 1100-1330, Dinner 1630-1830, Midnight 2300-0100; Sat-Sun: Breakfast 0730-0830, Lunch 1100-1330, Dinner 1630-1800, Midnight 2300-0030

resources.name: Dover Main Exchange (BX)
resources.description: Dover Main Exchange with food court, barber, beauty shop, optical, GNC, dry cleaning, and retail.

resources.name: Dover Federal Credit Union
resources.description: On-base federal credit union on base with ATM.

resources.name: Dover Fitness Center
resources.description: Main fitness facility with cardio, weights, group exercise, and sports amenities. 24/7 access for registered DoD ID holders.

resources.name: Unaccompanied Housing / Dorm Management
resources.description: Dormitory management and assignments. Multiple dorm buildings with dedicated management offices.

resources.name: Eagle's Rest Inn (AF Lodging)
resources.description: Official temporary lodging and TLF. 24-hour front desk for arrivals.
resources.hours: Lodging desk open 24 hours daily; check-in 1400, check-out 1100
resources.address: Bldg 800, Green Way, Dover AFB, DE 19902

resources.name: Military & Family Readiness Center (M&FRC)
resources.description: Relocation assistance, financial counseling, employment support, family programs, and Total Force readiness.

resources.name: 436th Force Support Squadron (FSS)
resources.description: Full MWR, dining, fitness, lodging, recreation, and family support programs.
resources.hours: Mon-Fri 0730-1630; facility hours on FSS website directory

resources.name: Dover Golf Course
resources.description: 18-hole golf course with pro shop and dining.

resources.name: Eagle Lanes Bowling Center
resources.description: Bowling alley with lanes and snack bar.

resources.name: 436th Medical Group
resources.description: Primary care, specialty clinics, and TRICARE services.

resources.name: Finance Office (Comptroller)
resources.description: Military pay, travel vouchers, and finance customer service.

sections.title: Required Documents
sections.body: PCS orders, CAC, medical/dental records, marriage and birth certificates if applicable, and travel receipts for finance settlement.

sections.title: Housing
sections.body: Contact Eagle's Rest Inn (302-677-2840) for initial arrival. Dormitory Management (302-677-2074) for unaccompanied housing. Family housing through privatized housing office.

sections.title: Quick Resources
sections.body: 436 FSS, M&FRC, and official Dover sites for in-processing and air mobility mission support.

sections.title: In-Processing Schedule
sections.body: Report to your gaining unit upon arrival and visit MPF within required timelines. Contact base lodging for after-hours arrivals.

sections.title: Sponsor Program
sections.body: Your sponsor should meet you upon arrival. Contact M&FRC if no sponsor is assigned before departure.
